old: Missing source files are reported while the last cached copy remains.

old: Create issues from selected elements with views that store camera position, cutting planes and snapshot, plus status, priority, type and comments.

old: Parameters of one placed object can be picked up and applied to another object of the same subtype, with parameters flagged unique left out.

reason: Page documents same-subtype transfer only; "parameters flagged unique are left out" is not on the page.

old: Let layer intersection groups decide which colliding elements may connect, and use junction order to settle equal-priority beams or walls.
new: Intersecting elements in the same layer intersection group connect to each other, while two elements both set to group 0 do not intersect.
reason: Cited page covers layer intersection groups; junction order is not mentioned on it.

old: Import and export schedule schemes among projects as XML, and let a scheme define which element information a published BIMx model shows, including text-and-link fields.
new: Import and export schedule schemes among projects as XML.
reason: The BIMx publishing clause is not on the cited Schedule contents page.

old: Cut holes into a slab by drawing a new contour within a selected slab, with straight or curved edges and optional custom edge angle and surface on the hole edges.
new: Cut a hole in a slab by selecting it and, with the Slab tool active, drawing a new contour inside its boundary, which is then treated as a hole.
reason: Page describes only the draw-a-contour method; curved edges, edge angle and hole surface are not covered.

old: Trim a shell to a contour polygon drawn in plan or section, and edit that contour by offsetting, turning its plane, dragging, rotating or mirroring.
new: Trim a shell to a contour by choosing Define Shell Contour in the floor plan or section and drawing a polygon (or picking an existing one with the Magic Wand).
reason: Editing the contour (offset, turn plane, drag, rotate, mirror) is on a separate page (Edit Shell Contour Polygon), not the cited one.

old: Select GI algorithm with sample counts and cache settings.
new: Global Illumination, available in the detailed Cineware PhotoRendering settings, simulates indirect light between surfaces for more realistic renders at the cost of longer render time.
reason: Cited page is a description of the GI effect; algorithm selection, sample counts and cache settings are not on it.

old: Customise the content and order of menus and store the command layout, including toolbars, as a command layout scheme in the work environment.
new: Customize the contents and arrangement of all program menus: move any command or menu into or out of any menu and reorder commands, using a searchable command list; context menus cannot be customized.
reason: Command layout schemes and toolbars are not on the Menu Customization page.

old: Every element carries a renovation status that decides how it appears in views and how it is counted in schedules.
new: Each element carries one of three renovation statuses (Existing by default, To be Demolished, New) that drive visual feedback in views.
reason: Schedule counting is not stated on the cited Renovation page.

old: Place a vertical or slanted column with rectangular, circular or complex-profile cross section by one-click, two-click or rotated input, with an optional veneer on non-profile sections.
new: Place a straight or slanted column using one of four geometry methods from the Info Box, including one-click placement and a two-click method whose second click sets the slant.
reason: Cross-section types and veneer are not described on the cited Place a Column page.
